name: My Living Things
source:
This is a short story about a boy and his imagination. Immerse yourself in Jeremy's world full of darkness, blood, pain, and hatred.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1688530/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这是一个关于一个男孩和他的想象力的短篇故事。让自己沉浸在杰里米充满黑暗、血腥、痛苦和仇恨的世界中。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1688530/]Steam[/url]]
